checks.name: census mine: OO "Columns" dialog (tab layout) — fields incl. "Number of columns", OK/Cancel, trigger
checks.detail: fields=["Number of columns","1","2","Equal column width","Column divider"] buttons=["OK","Cancel"] trigger=menu-item:Custom columns

checks.name: census route: Layout > Columns > "Custom columns" (data-cmd openColumnsDialog) opens the dialog
gated OO field "Number of columns" -> #columns-count number 1..6, default 2
Insert (3 / 42px) -> section[data-columns=3 data-column-gap=42] in the flat HTML
preset route: Layout > Columns > Two (data-cmd applyColumns) plants data-columns=2
Cancel mutates nothing (marker keeps the Two preset), dialog closes

declaredGaps: Per-column width spinners (1/2): collapse into the equal-width section mechanism (one data-column-gap knob — recorded divergence, not gated)
Equal column width: satisfied by mechanism — WO columns are equal-width by construction (no checkbox exists — recorded divergence, not gated)
Column divider: rule between columns deferred — the section marker has no divider attribute (recorded divergence, not gated)

contract.open: real clicks: census route Layout > Columns > "Custom columns" (data-cmd openColumnsDialog)
contract.title: Insert columns
contract.behavior: Insert wraps the caret position in section[data-columns][data-column-gap] (count clamps 1..6, gap clamps 0..200); the Layout > Columns presets (One/Two/Three/Left/Right) plant the same marker (asymmetric layouts add data-columns-layout); Cancel plants nothing
